$$
\int_{\frac{\pi}{12}}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} 4 \cot{\left(2 x \right)} \csc{\left(2 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "5706e08a-8a9b-5357-a5fc-b39f755d0330" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2.
$$

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=\frac{\pi}{12}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{\pi}{6}\\x=\frac{\pi}{4}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{\pi}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{\frac{\pi}{12}}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} 4 \cot{\left(2 x \right)} \csc{\left(2 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \cot{\left(u \right)} \csc{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \cot{\left(u \right)} \csc{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u=- \csc{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Endpoint values: $\csc{\left(\frac{\pi}{6} \right)}=2,\quad \csc{\left(\frac{\pi}{2} \right)}=1$.

Integrate and evaluate:

$$
\left[- 2 \csc{\left(u \right)}\right]_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}=\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right).
$$

The answer is

$$
2.
$$"] [:db/add "5706e08a-8a9b-5357-a5fc-b39f755d0330" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "5706e08a-8a9b-5357-a5fc-b39f755d0330" :question/answer-fields "1d79769f-4b26-543f-825e-ac05959c0c59"] [:db/ensure "5706e08a-8a9b-5357-a5fc-b39f755d0330" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068916 :knowledge-point/questions "5706e08a-8a9b-5357-a5fc-b39f755d0330"] [:db/add "8ffaa96d-b049-5220-bf5a-07c7510e2ad2" :answer/id #uuid "8ffaa96d-b049-5220-bf5a-07c7510e2ad2"] [:db/add "8ffaa96d-b049-5220-bf5a-07c7510e2ad2" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "8ffaa96d-b049-5220-bf5a-07c7510e2ad2" :answer/value "\frac{3}{2}"] [:db/ensure "8ffaa96d-b049-5220-bf5a-07c7510e2ad2" :answer/validate] [:db/add "d6bd7d1f-4f6f-536e-8b4f-280c1f7c4a2f" :answer-field/id #uuid "d6bd7d1f-4f6f-536e-8b4f-280c1f7c4a2f"] [:db/add "d6bd7d1f-4f6f-536e-8b4f-280c1f7c4a2f" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "d6bd7d1f-4f6f-536e-8b4f-280c1f7c4a2f" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "d6bd7d1f-4f6f-536e-8b4f-280c1f7c4a2f" :answer-field/choices "8ffaa96d-b049-5220-bf5a-07c7510e2ad2"] [:db/add "d6bd7d1f-4f6f-536e-8b4f-280c1f7c4a2f" :answer-field/correct "8ffaa96d-b049-5220-bf5a-07c7510e2ad2"] [:db/ensure "d6bd7d1f-4f6f-536e-8b4f-280c1f7c4a2f" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "7f5d3baa-87aa-5907-affa-f2b28b4b2bc3" :question/id #uuid "7f5d3baa-87aa-5907-affa-f2b28b4b2bc3"] [:db/add "7f5d3baa-87aa-5907-affa-f2b28b4b2bc3" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "7f5d3baa-87aa-5907-affa-f2b28b4b2bc3" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2.
$$

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=\frac{\pi}{8}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{\pi}{4}\\x=\frac{\pi}{4}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{\pi}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{\frac{\pi}{8}}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} 3 \csc^{2}{\left(2 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{2}\left(\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \csc^{2}{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \csc^{2}{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u=- \cot{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Endpoint values: $\cot{\left(\frac{\pi}{4} \right)}=1,\quad \cot{\left(\frac{\pi}{2} \right)}=0$.

Integrate and evaluate:

$$
\left[- \frac{3 \cot{\left(u \right)}}{2}\right]_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}=\left(0\right)-\left(- \frac{3}{2}\right).
$$

The answer is

$$
\frac{3}{2}.
$$"] [:db/add "7f5d3baa-87aa-5907-affa-f2b28b4b2bc3" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "7f5d3baa-87aa-5907-affa-f2b28b4b2bc3" :question/answer-fields "d6bd7d1f-4f6f-536e-8b4f-280c1f7c4a2f"] [:db/ensure "7f5d3baa-87aa-5907-affa-f2b28b4b2bc3" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068916 :knowledge-point/questions "7f5d3baa-87aa-5907-affa-f2b28b4b2bc3"] [:db/add "afbe65c0-9465-568c-bb98-33b813e778f6" :answer/id #uuid "afbe65c0-9465-568c-bb98-33b813e778f6"] [:db/add "afbe65c0-9465-568c-bb98-33b813e778f6" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "afbe65c0-9465-568c-bb98-33b813e778f6" :answer/value "\frac{3 \sec{\left(2 x \right)}}{2}"] [:db/ensure "afbe65c0-9465-568c-bb98-33b813e778f6" :answer/validate] [:db/add "47766019-c186-5964-863f-d273f2d556bd" :answer-field/id #uuid "47766019-c186-5964-863f-d273f2d556bd"] [:db/add "47766019-c186-5964-863f-d273f2d556bd" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "47766019-c186-5964-863f-d273f2d556bd" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "47766019-c186-5964-863f-d273f2d556bd" :answer-field/choices "afbe65c0-9465-568c-bb98-33b813e778f6"] [:db/add "47766019-c186-5964-863f-d273f2d556bd" :answer-field/correct "afbe65c0-9465-568c-bb98-33b813e778f6"] [:db/ensure "47766019-c186-5964-863f-d273f2d556bd" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "f9ef0223-5ac0-581e-a037-c22f02804cd5" :question/id #uuid "f9ef0223-5ac0-581e-a037-c22f02804cd5"] [:db/add "f9ef0223-5ac0-581e-a037-c22f02804cd5" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$

\left[2 \tan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{- \frac{\pi}{4}}^{0}=\left(0\right)-\left(-2\right).

$$

$$"] [:db/add "e1c02b6f-9b28-5b6e-9b46-7cfdd9245782" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "e1c02b6f-9b28-5b6e-9b46-7cfdd9245782" :question/answer-fields "c8e483e2-b82a-5637-b7f0-934231925d4a"] [:db/ensure "e1c02b6f-9b28-5b6e-9b46-7cfdd9245782" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068916 :knowledge-point/questions "e1c02b6f-9b28-5b6e-9b46-7cfdd9245782"] [:db/add "78d03258-3a91-5590-b9b2-678f9b0460f2" :answer/id #uuid "78d03258-3a91-5590-b9b2-678f9b0460f2"] [:db/add "78d03258-3a91-5590-b9b2-678f9b0460f2" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "78d03258-3a91-5590-b9b2-678f9b0460f2" :answer/value "- \frac{4 \cot{\left(3 x + 3 \right)}}{3}"] [:db/ensure "78d03258-3a91-5590-b9b2-678f9b0460f2" :answer/validate] [:db/add "bc0e3fba-d493-5233-ad84-cc68f3ace337" :answer-field/id #uuid "bc0e3fba-d493-5233-ad84-cc68f3ace337"] [:db/add "bc0e3fba-d493-5233-ad84-cc68f3ace337" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "bc0e3fba-d493-5233-ad84-cc68f3ace337" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "bc0e3fba-d493-5233-ad84-cc68f3ace337" :answer-field/choices "78d03258-3a91-5590-b9b2-678f9b0460f2"] [:db/add "bc0e3fba-d493-5233-ad84-cc68f3ace337" :answer-field/correct "78d03258-3a91-5590-b9b2-678f9b0460f2"] [:db/ensure "bc0e3fba-d493-5233-ad84-cc68f3ace337" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "4b79bc43-a386-5a26-8d0e-8a9d180ffc6c" :question/id #uuid "4b79bc43-a386-5a26-8d0e-8a9d180ffc6c"] [:db/add "4b79bc43-a386-5a26-8d0e-8a9d180ffc6c" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "20dc1f0e-e8bc-5bb4-b605-c55b3ca0b2ef" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x + 3$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=4.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int 4 \sec^{2}{\left(4 x + 3 \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int \sec^{2}{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \sec^{2}{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u=\tan{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
\int \sec^{2}{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u=\tan{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Substitute back:
